text:
nina_docs: Quick doc sync — PM flagged we need a clear migration path for anyone using v1 SDK/REST. Plan: a short migration doc + three tiny code examples (curl, py v2 client, and ruby). I'll open the PR after we decide wording.

leo_engineer: Agree. Also note the v1 -> v2 parameter renames and the altered error shapes. v1 used `model_id` + `prompt`; v2 expects `model` + `input`. Errors now include `code` and `hint`.

tera_pm: Timeline: announce deprecation in-console and email partners 45 days before cut-off. Partners on Dedicated want a heads-up earlier. Can we include a note for Dedicated/Private customers that no automatic redirect will be applied?

nina_docs: Yes — include a "Dedicated/Private" blurb with instructions: update routing to accept /v2/model-serve and update any gateway rewrites. We'll also add a sample nginx snippet.

leo_engineer: Draft nginx snippet: ```nginx
location /v1/models/ {
  return 301 /docs/migrate/v1-to-v2;
}
# For hosted accounts we'll add a server-side redirect instead
```

deploy-bot: Auto-note: Please file an infra ticket for hosted redirect rules and console banner feature flag.

nina_docs: For examples I want to avoid large code blocks. Proposed curl pair:
```bash
# v1
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"Translate to FR: Hello"}'

# v2
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/model-serve -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-translate","input":"Translate to FR: Hello"}'
```

leo_engineer: For Python show exact call rename. v1: `client.generate(model_id='x', prompt='y')` -> v2: `client.model_serve.create(model='x', input='y')`. Also update expected response accessors: v1 used `resp.text`, v2 uses `resp.outputs[0].content`.

nina_docs: Add a tiny inline diff block in the migration doc, reviewers like that. I'll keep it 3 lines.

tera_pm: Communications: I'll draft the admin email template for Dedicated customers. Include migration steps + rollback notes.

samira_support: Add a short troubleshooting FAQ in the doc: common errors when switching (401 from changed auth scopes, 422 for input shape mismatch). That reduces support churn.

leo_engineer: Streaming differences: v2 streaming pushes chunked JSON objects with `delta` fields. Node/eventsource example should show parsing `data: {...}` events. Are we adding Node? nina_docs: I'd rather replace Node with Ruby for variety — most user-facing examples already have Node elsewhere.

nina_docs: Ruby snippet proposal:```ruby
# v2 simple call
resp = Net::HTTP.post(URI('https://api.redwood.ai/v2/model-serve'), {model: 'redwood-mini', input: 'Hi'}.to_json, {'Authorization' => "Bearer #{ENV['KEY']}", 'Content-Type' => "application/json"})
```

leo_engineer: Make sure we mention SDK versions: v2 clients 2.0.0+; add pip/npm/gem install lines.

deploy-bot: CI reminder: add a docs smoke test that runs the curl example against a mocked local endpoint to catch regressions.

nina_docs: Good. Checklist for the PR:
- migration guide page with short explanation of behavior changes
- curl, python, ruby snippets and a 3-line inline diff
- Dedicated/Private section + nginx template and partner email copy
- redirect infra ticket number linked
- changelog entry and docs CI smoke test
- small FAQ with common failure patterns

tera_pm: I'll own partner email and status page release note. Please tag me on the PR.

leo_engineer: I'll add the nginx snippet and the SDK response shape note. Also adding a small test for the streaming shape.

samira_support: I'll write the FAQ entries and a recommended support response template.

nina_docs: Thanks all — I'll open PR 1402 and tag reviewers. Aim to merge by 2026-05-05 so infra has time to deploy before enforcement on 2026-06-01. If anyone has wording objection, comment on the PR. :rocket:
